source: Statistics Canada, Canadian Survey on Business Conditions, table 33-10-1207-01
scope: Estimate the share of respondents planning to use AI in the next 12 months to produce goods or deliver services, stated at the third quarter of 2026. Show Canada and Quebec for all industries, information and cultural industries, and professional, scientific and technical services. Retain survey quality symbols and cell identifiers. Treat Quebec-minus-Canada as a descriptive percentage-point difference. No inference about realized adoption, individual demand, or significance.
question_en: Where does reported intention to use AI differ between Quebec and Canada across the selected industries?
question_fr: Pour les secteurs retenus, où l’intention déclarée d’utiliser l’IA diffère-t-elle entre le Québec et le Canada?
incumbent: Official CSV and conventional exact column filters under the same data access. Statistics Canada’s October 1 official release gives direct national comparator values.
acceptance: Require language editions to match exact vector, period, coordinate, geography ID, percent scale, value, and quality. Require independently written conventional EN extract and published national values to agree. Report limitations and leave the published result scoped to the declared survey.
